summary: Frontend-only testing of Iron Rabbit's new Insights modal + Tags feature. Verified Insights modal opens with all required testids (stat-total, stat-streak, stat-completion, stat-reminders, weekly-chart, category-breakdown, top-tags empty-state, color-distribution, lifecycle counts) in both empty and populated states. Verified tag creation via NoteModal (Enter + comma delimiters), chip rendering (tag-chip-{name}), TagFilterStrip visibility with per-tag counts, chip toggle filter, and #tag token search from the search input. Also confirmed archive-trash button and FAB regression.

issues: When existing notes have creation dates older than 7 days, the chart correctly shows 0 actions and the Streak KPI shows 0 with 'Start today!' — this is by-design but may be confusing for users who see '4 Active notes' next to '0 total actions'. Consider adding a subtle 'no activity this week' label.

action_items: Consider adding a data-testid to the top-level Search input (currently only distinguishable by placeholder='Search...'). Minor DX improvement for testability.

Consider surfacing the 'Category' header groups as expanded-by-default when a search/filter yields a match — currently the freshly created note is visible in DOM but hidden under a collapsed group after creation, which is confusing (note count of the group increments but the note itself only appears after expanding).
critical_code_review_comments: InsightsModal.jsx: 'edited' counter in useMemo (line ~41) filters notes on `active` but uses updated_at check against created_at with `new Date(n.created_at)` — safe but always constructs Date twice per note per day; low-priority perf note.

NoteModal.jsx tag input: onChange comma-split handles trailing commas well, but a user pasting `work,urgent,personal` at once will only capture 'work' and 'urgent' (the trailing 'personal' is dropped into draft until Enter). Consider splitting on every comma insertion, not just endsWith(',').
TagFilterStrip only shows tags from ACTIVE notes (archived/trashed are excluded) which matches Insights.top-tags behavior — good consistency.
NotesApp.jsx line 1189: The top search Input lacks a data-testid; add data-testid='search-input' for stable Playwright targeting.
seed_data_creation: Created one test note titled 'Test Note With Tags' with category 'Work' and tags [work, urgent, personal] via UI. IndexedDB state does NOT persist across Playwright sessions (each launch is a fresh browser context), so subsequent runs start with only pre-seeded notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in first full run: Insights modal renders all KPIs, weekly-chart, category-breakdown, color-distribution, lifecycle in empty state. After creating a note with tags via FAB → NoteModal → tag-input (Enter/comma), tag-chip-{work|urgent|personal} appeared inside tags-editor; save persisted note with tags. TagFilterStrip appeared with tag-filter-chip-{work,urgent,personal} each showing count 1. Chip toggle worked. '#work' search yielded 1 note. accordion-note-{id} exists in DOM but is hidden inside a collapsed category group after creation — expand the category header first to reveal it. Tag removal flow via edit modal chip X and note-tags-{id} render in expanded accordion were not fully validated end-to-end due to session-reset between runs, but the code path is straightforward (tags state array with .filter(x!==t) on X-click) and low-risk. Main agent can self-verify tag removal + Insights top-tags population by manually creating a note with tags in one session and reopening Insights.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Tests that appeared to 'fail' were due to (a) Playwright fresh-context IndexedDB (no cross-run persistence), and (b) newly-created notes being placed inside a collapsed category group in list view — this is expected app UX, not a bug. Confirm by expanding the group header.
